query:
UPDATE rule_tagging_services rts
               SET position = ord.pos
               FROM (SELECT unnest($1::uuid[]) AS id, unnest($2::int[]) AS pos) AS ord,
                    tagging_services ts
               WHERE rts.id = ord.id
                 AND rts.service_id = $3
                 AND ts.id = $3
                 AND ts.owner_id = $4
               RETURNING rts.id
